role: The stone (70, mobs) and wooden (72, everything) pressure plates: which entities press the plate and the 0/15 power mapping.
scope_reason: In scope: the stone and wooden plates' entity scan (func_150065_e by sensitivity) decides the pressed metadata the oracle writes with redstone = off; it ran in golem-fight-s42, village-rain-s42 and village-siege-s42.

members.name: field_150069_a
members.note: the sensitivity by block id: the stone plate (70, mobs) counts livings, the wooden plate (72, everything) every entity; no vanilla plate uses players

members.name: func_150060_c
members.note: metadata 1 reads as 15 (sr_plate_tick, sr_plate_collide, blockcb.c bwl_on_broken)

members.name: func_150065_e
members.note: the scan by sensitivity with doesEntityNotTriggerPressurePlate (the bat): 15 or 0; rs-wire-s1 presses the stone plate with the player and the wooden one with a dropped stack and an XP orb; like Java's chunk-list read it counts entities already dead this tick (an item picked up earlier in the tick still presses the plate): plate-dead-s1
